23.title: Coalesce hover prefetches in server router cache
23.body: Closes #22. Adds an in-flight prefetch map keyed by URL so a second prefetch for the same key reuses the pending promise instead of racing.

201.title: Reset useFormState dispatcher on route change
201.body: Closes #200. Clears the action dispatcher reference when the client router transitions, preventing stale state from leaking into the next route's form.

30.title: Normalize build manifest paths to posix
30.body: Closes #29. Wraps emitted manifest paths in path.posix.normalize so builds produced on Windows load correctly on Linux runtimes.
